title: Require effective in-container cgroup limits before syntax compilation
summary: Added a fixed fail-closed runtime guard inside the P00 rootless Docker syntax broker to check effective cgroup-v2 memory, process and CPU limits plus loopback-only interface and read-only root before parsing model-authored Python. Unit tests verify trusted rule logic and mocked denial; live worker host and OS containment remain unverified.
migration_notes: No released app or user data changed. Unprovisioned Docker gate stays disabled. After operator-owned rootless host deployment, the exact limit values must be independently observed and negative-tested before any sandbox readiness claim.
